integrity: The exact algebraic identity and rational checks are reproducible from the standalone script; finite tests are not presented as an infinite probabilistic proof. Scientific claims have same-model review only; no independent validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Top operator-norm exponent only for independently identically distributed timesteps supported strictly in (0,2), on the unit harmonic oscillator. No formula or quantitative lower bound for the positive exponent, no correlated or feedback-driven step model, no higher-dimensional nonlinear extension. The general Furstenberg theorem is a cited external mathematical input.
title: Every nonconstant independent stable timestep destabilizes velocity Verlet almost surely
